subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Definir o recorte temático da entrevista e o entrevistado, levantar informações sobre o entrevistado e sobre o tema da entrevista, elaborar roteiro de perguntas, realizar entrevista, a partir do roteiro, abrindo possibilidades para fazer perguntas a partir da resposta, se o contexto permitir, tomar nota, gravar ou salvar a entrevista e usar adequadamente as informações obtidas, de acordo com os objetivos estabelecidos.

components.description_pt: Definir foco temático e identificar entrevistado apropriado para entrevista planejada
components.description_en: Define a thematic focus and identify an appropriate interviewee for a planned interview
components.cc_component_description: Identify and focus a research question around a specific topic

components.description_pt: Desenvolver roteiro de perguntas baseado em pesquisa prévia sobre entrevistado e tema
components.description_en: Develop a question guide based on background research about the interviewee and topic
components.cc_component_description: Formulate a focused research question to guide a short or sustained inquiry

components.description_pt: Conduzir entrevista seguindo roteiro e fazendo perguntas de acompanhamento quando apropriado
components.description_en: Conduct an interview following the guide while asking relevant follow-up questions when appropriate
components.cc_component_description: Generate focused follow-up questions based on gathered information from multiple sources

components.description_pt: Registrar ou anotar informações durante entrevista e usá-las conforme objetivos estabelecidos
components.description_en: Record or take notes during an interview and use the information obtained in accordance with established objectives
components.cc_component_description: Take brief notes on sources while researching a topic

cc_matches.description: Conduct short research projects that build knowledge about a topic.

Conduct short as well as more sustained research projects to answer a question (including a self-generated question) or solve a problem; narrow or broaden the inquiry when appropriate; synthesize multiple sources on the subject, demonstrating understanding of the subject under investigation.
Recall information from experiences or gather information from print and digital sources; take brief notes on sources and sort evidence into provided categories.

Gather relevant information from multiple print and digital sources, using search terms effectively; assess the credibility and accuracy of each source; and quote or paraphrase the data and conclusions of others while avoiding plagiarism and following a standard format for citation.
